query: SELECT cb.coffee_type, cb.coffee_grade, SUM(sii.qty) AS qty_sold, SUM(sii.amount) AS revenue, SUM(sii.qty * cb.cost_per_kg) AS cogs, SUM(sii.amount) - SUM(sii.qty * cb.cost_per_kg) AS gross_profit, CASE WHEN SUM(sii.amount) > 0 THEN (SUM(sii.amount) - SUM(sii.qty * cb.cost_per_kg)) / SUM(sii.amount) * 100 ELSE 0 END AS profit_margin_pct FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` sii INNER JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name = sii.parent INNER JOIN `tabCoffee Batch` cb ON cb.custom_item_code = sii.item_code WHERE si.docstatus = 1 AND cb.is_grade_batch = 1 GROUP BY cb.coffee_type, cb.coffee_grade ORDER BY gross_profit DESC
name: Grade-wise Profitability Report
